cases.feature: Backend page boundaries, history, owner/audience isolation and trusted-actor limits
cases.observed: Three added service cases cover 160 records, second/later pages, text/session/proof exclusion, token and version history, invalid inputs and actor spoofing.
cases.recommendation: Reassess offset/count costs for much larger histories; use cursor/shared storage before multiple API coordinators.

cases.feature: Full application regressions in local and exact VPS C image
cases.observed: 260/260 in both environments; VPS isolated container limited to one CPU and 1 GiB.
cases.recommendation: Keep the exact-image test step for future releases.

cases.observed: Final VPS fixture: 0 failures; 115.84 ms p95; 378.45 ms max; 3947-byte largest response; 118 MiB process RSS. Per-actor limits are retained separately from the shared-network ceiling.
cases.recommendation: Synthetic auth and loopback transport; excludes external auth, models, parsing, production WAN and long-duration traffic. These figures do not establish full copilot capacity.

cases.feature: Analytics consent and owner pairing lifecycle through the tabbed UI
cases.observed: Six isolated browser scenarios pass: analytics opt-in, private-value exclusion, group list, owner expiry extension, shortening/revocation and visitor analytics opt-out.
cases.recommendation: Production policies remain unchanged; keep synthetic lifecycle testing separate from real visitor analytics.

cases.feature: Signed-in administrator uses all seven deployed tabs and switches domains
cases.observed: Actual VPS: local registration 47 sources (25 + 22), 10 workflows, 7 observed pages, 2 saved groups; isolated public Flolah registration 34 observed pages with a successful 10-row page change. Settings clear on switch. No owner policy, publication or host record changed.
cases.recommendation: Review the public map page and local source page screenshots. Live existing indexes were read, not seeded for this test.

cases.feature: Fresh live email-owner sign-in on the final workspace
cases.observed: The existing email-owner session expired. Its sign-in gate is displayed correctly. Live selected-site checks used the existing signed-in platform administrator; isolated owner-role UI and owner API regression tests pass. No new code/email was requested.
cases.recommendation: Complete fresh live email-owner re-entry when the owner next signs in. Existing Safari/iOS, Android and screen-reader deferrals, broad-agent coverage and local-checker timeout retain earlier status.

limits: Analytics tables paginate an existing bounded aggregate report; this is not raw-event server pagination.
Source-map manifests and histories are bounded JSON records; API slicing bounds transfer, not every internal read.
Offset paging is not a frozen snapshot across concurrent changes; use refresh after mutations.
One SQLite coordinator remains; two parser workers are unchanged. No API HA or Kubernetes capacity claim.
Global maker/checker remains Off; website capabilities, preview duration, Action Policies and model selection were not changed.
